title: Trump orders contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress

blocks.text: NEW YORK — President Donald Trump is directing federal contractors and subcontractors to consult with his administration about inquiries they receive from Congress and to withhold any communications that the White House considers privileged, according to a new executive order. The companies must also coordinate with the White House and U.S. agencies on “appropriate responses”
